body: The coupler downstream performance pipeline is often blocked by the `experiments/AMIP` compat. This PR changes the pipeline to delete the compat section for `UPSTREAM_PACKAGES`, a list of packages matching the  ClimaCoupler coarse nightly AMIP pipeline.
title: Remove compat for coupler downstream performance test
